article.title: Who Should Pay for Climate Adaptation?

paragraphs.en: Climate adaptation is becoming a central concern for governments facing more frequent or severe hazards. Flood barriers, cooling centers, improved drainage, and resilient transport networks can protect lives and economic activity. Yet their benefits are difficult to allocate to individual payers. A household may receive direct protection, while a hospital or transport line serves people from a much wider region. Governments must therefore answer two connected questions: which investments are justified, and who should finance them? The answer cannot rest on engineering alone. It also depends on judgments about fairness, economic incentives, and the distribution of risks.
paragraphs.zh: 氣候調適逐漸成為政府的重要議題，防洪堤、避暑中心、排水改善與韌性交通可保護生命及經濟活動，但效益難以分配到個別付款者。家庭可能直接受保護，醫院或交通線卻服務更廣區域。政府因此須回答哪些投資合理、誰該出資。答案不只涉及工程，也關係公平、經濟誘因與風險分配。
paragraphs.ja: 気候適応は洪水対策、避暑施設、排水改善、交通網の強化などを含む。利益は地域を越えて広がるため、投資の妥当性と負担者を同時に考えなければならない。

paragraphs.en: The beneficiary-pays principle appears straightforward. If a new seawall protects expensive waterfront properties, their owners might reasonably contribute to its cost. Targeted charges can also make the link between spending and benefits visible. But the approach becomes less convincing when protection extends to schools, emergency services, and workers who commute from elsewhere. A property-based fee might place a disproportionate burden on residents with low incomes or limited savings. It could even encourage relocation from areas where communities have deep historical ties. Defining beneficiaries is therefore not simply a matter of drawing a boundary around a construction site.
paragraphs.zh: 受益者付費看似直接。若海堤保護高價濱海房產，屋主分擔似乎合理；專項收費也讓支出與效益連結更清楚。但當防護延伸到學校、緊急服務與外地通勤者時，原則就不那麼簡單。依房產收費可能對低收入或儲蓄有限的居民造成不成比例負擔，甚至迫使與當地有深厚歷史連結的社區遷移。界定受益者不能只在工地周圍畫線。
paragraphs.ja: 受益者負担は分かりやすいが、学校や救急サービス、通勤者も恩恵を受ける。固定資産への課金は低所得世帯に重い負担となる可能性があり、受益者の範囲を慎重に考える必要がある。

paragraphs.en: Ability to pay provides an alternative principle. Progressive taxation allows wealthier households and more profitable firms to contribute a greater share, while protecting vulnerable residents from unaffordable charges. This approach recognizes that essential safety should not be reserved for people who can purchase it. However, nationwide funding can generate conflict between regions. Taxpayers in relatively low-risk areas may object to financing costly defenses in distant communities. Advocates of solidarity respond that major disasters can disrupt supply chains, public services, and national markets. Sharing costs may thus serve collective economic interests as well as ethical commitments.
paragraphs.zh: 支付能力是另一原則。累進稅制讓富裕家庭與高獲利企業分擔較多，同時避免脆弱居民承擔無法支付的費用。基本安全不應只留給買得起的人。但全國融資可能引發區域衝突。低風險地區納稅人可能反對支付遠方社區的昂貴防護。支持團結互助者指出重大災害會衝擊供應鏈、公共服務與全國市場，分攤成本既可能符合共同經濟利益，也具有倫理理由。
paragraphs.ja: 支払能力に応じた負担は弱い立場の人を守るが、地域間で税負担への反発が起こる。災害は全国の供給網や公共サービスに影響するため、費用分担には共通利益もある。

paragraphs.en: Historical responsibility adds an international dimension. Communities that contributed relatively little to cumulative greenhouse gas emissions may face serious climate threats. Meanwhile, some of the wealth associated with carbon-intensive development accumulated in other places. This imbalance supports arguments for international financial assistance. Yet allocating precise obligations remains politically difficult because countries differ in historical emissions, current income, population, and exposure to danger. Funding can take the form of grants, concessional loans, insurance, or technical support. These instruments are not equivalent: a loan may increase the debt burden of a government already struggling to maintain essential services.
paragraphs.zh: 歷史責任帶來國際面向。對累積溫室氣體排放貢獻較少的社區可能承受嚴重威脅，而高碳發展相關財富累積在別處。這種不平衡支持國際財政援助的主張。但各國歷史排放、目前收入、人口與風險不同，具體義務難以分配。資金可採補助、優惠貸款、保險或技術支援，工具並不等價：貸款可能加重本就難以維持基本服務的政府債務。
paragraphs.ja: 歴史的排出責任も国際支援の論点になる。補助金、優遇融資、保険、技術協力は同じではない。融資は財政の弱い国に追加の債務負担を生むことがある。

paragraphs.en: Private markets can finance some protective investments. Businesses have incentives to strengthen facilities, diversify suppliers, and reduce interruptions. Insurers may adjust premiums to reflect risks, while lenders may consider climate exposure when evaluating assets. But markets are less likely to provide sufficient protection where benefits cannot be captured through private revenue. An early-warning system can serve entire communities regardless of whether each resident pays a fee. Public investment may therefore be necessary. The challenge is to distinguish genuinely collective needs from projects that mainly transfer public resources to a narrow set of private beneficiaries.
paragraphs.zh: 私人市場能資助部分防護投資。企業有誘因強化設施、分散供應商並降低中斷。保險公司可依風險調整保費，貸款人可在資產評估時考慮氣候暴露。但若效益難以轉為私人收入，市場可能提供不足。預警系統能服務整個社區，不論居民是否付費，因此可能需要公共投資。挑戰是區分真正的集體需求與主要把公共資源轉移給少數私人受益者的工程。
paragraphs.ja: 企業や保険会社も対策に投資できる。しかし早期警報など広く利益が及ぶ公共財は市場だけでは不足しやすい。公的資金が一部の私的受益者に偏らないか確認する必要がある。

paragraphs.en: Time makes evaluation harder. Adaptation costs are immediate, while prevented losses may occur many years later. A flood that does not happen creates no obvious revenue, even if a barrier helped avoid enormous damage. Conventional financial appraisal may underestimate health, safety, and the continuity of essential services. Decision makers should examine several plausible scenarios instead of relying on a single prediction. Flexible infrastructure can be valuable when future conditions are uncertain, especially if it allows expansion without complete replacement. Transparent assumptions make it easier to revise decisions as evidence changes.
paragraphs.zh: 時間使評估更困難。調適成本立即發生，避免的損失可能多年後才出現。即使防洪堤避免巨大損害，未發生的洪水也不會帶來明顯收入。傳統財務評估可能低估健康、安全與基本服務不中斷的價值。決策者應比較多個合理情境，而非依賴單一預測。若未來不確定，可擴充而無須全部重建的彈性基礎設施很有價值。透明假設便於隨證據更新決策。
paragraphs.ja: 適応費用は先に発生し、回避できた損失は直接見えない。健康や安全、サービス継続も評価に含め、複数の将来シナリオと柔軟な設計を検討する必要がある。

paragraphs.en: Distributional consequences can be severe. A flood wall might increase property values inside its boundary while redirecting water toward an unprotected district. Relocation may improve physical safety but disrupt employment, family networks, and cultural connections. An investment that appears efficient overall can impose concentrated losses on particular groups. Public consultation must therefore involve renters, older residents, people with disabilities, and small businesses, not only property owners and major employers. Compensation and transition assistance may be necessary when unavoidable burdens fall on those with limited influence. Fairness requires examining who loses as carefully as who benefits.
paragraphs.zh: 分配後果可能很嚴重。防洪牆可能提高牆內房價，卻把水導向未受保護地區。遷居可改善人身安全，卻破壞就業、家庭網絡與文化連結。整體看似有效率的投資，可能讓特定群體承擔集中損失。公共諮詢應包含租屋者、長者、身心障礙者及小企業，而非只有屋主和大型雇主。若無法避免的負擔落在影響力有限的人身上，可能需要補償與轉型協助。公平須同樣仔細檢視誰受損。
paragraphs.ja: 防護壁が別の地域へ水を流す場合もある。移転は安全性を高めても仕事や人間関係を損なう。借家人や高齢者などを含めて協議し、必要な補償を検討する。

paragraphs.en: Budget constraints make prioritization unavoidable. Governments cannot protect every building, road, and neighborhood against every possible hazard immediately. They need criteria that consider risk severity, exposed populations, critical services, and the feasibility of different interventions. Selecting projects solely by property value could favor wealthy districts, while dividing funds equally may ignore large differences in danger. Officials should explain why some projects are urgent and others can wait. A credible process includes opportunities to challenge decisions and revise priorities when new information becomes available. Accountability matters because the costs of mistakes may be borne by people who had little influence over the original choice.
paragraphs.zh: 預算限制讓排序無可避免。政府無法立即保護每棟建築、道路和社區免於所有危害。標準應考量風險嚴重性、暴露人口、關鍵服務與方案可行性。只看房產價值可能偏向富裕地區，平均分配則可能忽略危險程度差異。官員應解釋哪些工程緊急、哪些可等待。可信的程序包含質疑決策和依新資訊修訂優先順序的機會。問責很重要，因為錯誤成本可能由原本沒有決策影響力的人承擔。
paragraphs.ja: 予算が限られるため優先順位が必要だ。資産価値だけで選べば裕福な地域に偏り、均等配分では危険度の差を無視する。判断基準と見直しの機会を明示することが重要だ。

paragraphs.en: No universal formula can allocate adaptation costs fairly in every setting. A workable policy combines principles: beneficiaries contribute where appropriate, taxpayers support essential public protection, and targeted assistance prevents vulnerable households from being excluded. International cooperation may address inequalities that domestic budgets cannot solve. Evaluation should explain who pays, who benefits, what risks remain, and when decisions will be reviewed. The objective is not merely to construct more infrastructure. It is to protect lives and livelihoods while distributing burdens in ways citizens can understand, scrutinize, and reasonably regard as fair. Equity is part of effective risk management, not a decorative addition afterward.
paragraphs.zh: 沒有單一公式能在所有情境公平分配調適成本。可行政策結合原則：適當時由受益者出資，基本公共防護由納稅人支持，針對性協助避免脆弱家庭被排除。國際合作可處理國內預算無法解決的差距。評估應說明誰付款、誰受益、剩餘風險及檢討時機。目標不只是興建更多設施，而是保護生命與生計，並以公民能理解、監督且合理認為公平的方式分配負擔。公平是有效風險管理的一部分，不是事後裝飾。
paragraphs.ja: 万能の負担公式はない。受益者負担、税による公共保護、弱い立場への支援、国際協力を組み合わせる。負担と利益、残るリスクを透明に説明することが重要だ。
